paragraphs.text: Lagomos is a human shaman in the Cabal on Dominaria .

A leader among the Cabal during Belzenlok 's reign, he kept the group from falling apart after the demon's death. Though he believes his rightful place lies in the cult's leadership, he was forced to kneel to Braids after her return from dementia space .
Tuan Duong Chu 's art for Lagomos, Hand of Hatred is labeled "Ignia, Rage Weaver", implying this was the character and card's original name.
